title: Earning Credits on Completed Stays — Roamhaven Rewards
content:
## Clause

A completed stay earns Roamhaven Rewards credits at the earn rate of the member's tier on the check-out date, applied to the stay's eligible spend (the nightly subtotal and the cleaning fee, net of refunds). When the stay's host account was a Superhost on the check-out date, the Superhost-stay bonus percentage of the eligible spend is added and booked as a separate Superhost-stay bonus. The total for the stay is cut to the per-stay maximum of the member's tier and rounded to the nearest cent, half up. Each tier applies its own earn rate and its own per-stay maximum.

The credits earned on the stay are defined as: the eligible spend multiplied by the tier's earn rate taken as a percentage, rounded to the nearest cent, half up; or the tier's per-stay maximum where that is lower. Because the per-stay maximum applies to the stay's total, bonus included, the Superhost-stay bonus is no more than the part of the maximum that the credits earned leave unused.

## Conditions

- **Active membership.** Credits are earned only while the membership is active. The status that counts is the status shown on the member's own membership record.
- **Posting.** Credits post the number of calendar days after check-out set for the member's tier.
- **Cancelled stays.** Stays cancelled by the guest or by the host earn nothing.
- **Non-refundable rate.** Stays booked at a non-refundable rate earn when the tier's term for non-refundable-rate stays says they earn.
- **Once per stay.** A stay earns once. A stay that already shows a credits-earned entry on the member's statement does not earn again.

## Worked stays (hypothetical figures)

Suppose, for illustration, a member whose tier earns 2.50 percent with a per-stay maximum of 400.00 credits, and a Superhost-stay bonus of 0.50 percent.

| Stay | Eligible spend (USD) | Host account Superhost on check-out date? | Credits earned | Superhost-stay bonus | Stay total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 1350.00 | Yes | 33.75 | 6.75 | 40.50 |
| B | 1350.00 | No | 33.75 | none | 33.75 |
| C | 17000.00 | No | 400.00 (425.00 cut to the maximum) | none | 400.00 |
| D | 16000.00 | Yes | 400.00 | none (the credits earned already use the whole maximum) | 400.00 |

Rounding on a different hypothetical rate: eligible spend of 1234.50 USD at 2.25 percent comes to 27.77625 credits, which rounds half up to 27.78 credits.

## Outcome table

| The stay | The membership on the member's record | Credits earned |
|---|---|---|
| Completed, no credits-earned entry yet | Active | Yes, as defined above |
| Completed | Pending confirmation, suspended or closed | No |
| Cancelled by the guest | Any | No |
| Cancelled by the host | Any | No |
| Completed, already shows a credits-earned entry | Any | No further earning |
